findings.message: The adapter accepts any configurationDigest when ID/version match, so a bound invocation can be redirected to a different repositoryPath or executable configuration.
evidenceRef hashes command records but discards the records; RawIntegrationEffectResult cites native evidence that no caller can retrieve or verify.

The conformance suite does not independently exercise denied spawn, interrupted process, wrong target, changed operation, configuration-digest substitution, or evidence-sink substitution despite the task acceptance contract.

requiredCorrections: Define one canonical serializable adapter configuration material (repositoryPath, gitExecutable, bounded timeout/policy fields), compute its configurationDigest, and require invocation.adapter to match ID, version, and that exact digest before any Git call.

Require a host-owned persistNativeEvidence(bytes, metadata) callback or equivalent evidence store. Persist canonical command-evidence bytes, validate the returned ArtifactRef digest against those exact bytes, and only then cite it in RawIntegrationEffectResult. Never fabricate an unretrievable ref.
Add a bounded Git timeout and preserve timeout/signal as interrupted evidence; do not hang indefinitely.

Add explicit zero-effect or fail-closed fixtures for configuration substitution, wrong target, changed/resealed operation versus the Core authorization supplied by the host, denied spawn, interrupted process, malformed evidence-store response, and native-evidence byte retrieval/digest verification.

Preserve all three clean strategies, isolated candidate preparation, conflict no-mutation, atomic update-ref expected-old behavior, plug-in conformance, and the rule that only Core may supply target/operation authority.
